sentences.text: CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SUJIT NARAYAN PRASAD -------

For the Petitioner : Mr. Ashish Kr. Shekhar, Advocate For the Respondents : Mr. Ashutosh Anand,
AAG-III ------

The grievance of the writ petitioner, by way of filing the instant writ petition, is that even though he is co-sharer of the property in question, which has been acquired in view of provision of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 but not a single penny by way of compensation has been paid in favour of writ petitioner while some amount of compensation has been paid in favour of respondent no. 4.
It is also the grievance of the writ petitioner that even though the fact about pendency of partition suit being Partition Suit No. 71 of 2013 has been brought notice to the Deputy Commissioner prior to passing of the Award i.e. by making such application on 28.07.2021 which has duly been received in the office of concerned respondent but even then some compensation has been paid in favour of respondent no. 4 while not a single penny has been paid in favour of petitioner.
